Name: Adjustible Silo Size
Author: shrikeexitium
Description:
[color=#9900ff][size=4][b]Adjustable Silo Size[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]Tired of needing multiple silos to feed all your animals? Confused why the silo has such terrible storage capacity compared to even a single inventory slot? Hate wasting all that potential hay every time you cut grass with a full silo? Adjustable Silo Storage is here to remedy all these ills![/size]

[size=3]With the simple click of a GMCM dropdown the hay capacity of silos can be adjusted to ten or even one hundred times the default value![/size]

[color=#9900ff][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]Should be compatible with anything.[/size]

[color=#9900ff][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]Requires GMCM and Content Patcher.[/size]
